Location: Minneapolis, MN (Remote)Job Summary:
Skillset: Azure Data factory, Databricks, SQL, Spark Scala, and couple internal frameworks (ADF template & Data-at-scale)

Add-ons: Reusable Spark framework development. API development & integration from Spark Scala. Java Script to enhance existing framework to integrate with Azure APIs.
